parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic and printed with a world map. It is approximately 20 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It represents the Earth and can rotate around its axis to show different continents and countries.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the supporting axis attached to the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is a metallic stand that supports the globe sphere, typically made of steel or aluminum wire.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and allows the sphere to be held upright while enabling rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
